title: Underlying sets commute with abelian sheaf inverse image
statement: Let C and D be small categories with Grothendieck topologies J and K [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let U : C → D be continuous. Suppose the constructed set-valued sheaf pullback L preserves finite limits. Let A be the constructed abelian sheaf pullback, and let V_J and V_K forget the abelian group structure of a sheaf. Then there is a natural isomorphism A ⋙ V_K ≅ V_J ⋙ L. No covering-family, finite-colimit or representable-flatness hypothesis is required beyond continuity and finite-limit preservation of L.

source.place: Section 00YR and Proposition 00YV (2); also sites-modules.tex, first paragraph of Lemma 04JC

proof.text: Identify abelian sheaves on C and D with commutative group objects in sheaves of sets, compatibly with forgetting their structure, using the abelian component alone.

The set-valued sheaf pullback is left adjoint to continuous pushforward. Its finite-limit preservation supplies finite products; its right adjoint preserves limits. Lift this adjunction to commutative group objects. Its underlying left functor is precisely set-valued pullback, by the strict forgetful equality of the lifted-commutative-group theorem.

Identify the transported right functor with abelian pushforward. On each object of C it is the same group of sections over U(X); the right-adjoint product and terminal comparisons are the sectionwise identifications, so the displayed transported multiplication, unit and inverse equations identify its addition, zero and negation. This gives a natural isomorphism of the right functors, including their action on homomorphisms.

Transport the group-object adjunction across these equivalences. Both its left functor and constructed abelian sheaf pullback are left adjoint to abelian continuous pushforward. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies them. Whisker by the forgetful functor, then compose with the strict underlying equalities to obtain the claimed natural isomorphism.

theorem sitePullback_abelian_underlying
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D) (U : C ⥤ D)
    [U.IsContinuous J K]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback U (Type u) J K)] :
    Nonempty (sheafPullback U AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K ⋙
        sheafCompose K (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≅
      sheafCompose J (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⋙ sheafPullback U (Type u) J K)
